schema.description: The informational compliance scorecard of a seller over a rolling window (ADR 0005). Additive; no event carries it.

windowEnd.description: The end of the window (inclusive); the instant the scorecard was computed.

shipmentsReceived.description: Shipments that closed (`CLOSED` or `CLOSED_WITH_DISCREPANCY`) in the window.

cartonsReported.description: Cartons the closing receipts reported, whatever their status.

cartonsReceived.description: Of those, the cartons with status `RECEIVED`.

receiptAccuracyRate.description: `cartonsReceived / cartonsReported`, four decimals. Omitted when `cartonsReported` is 0.

discrepancyRatePerShipment.description: Discrepancies recorded in the window divided by `shipmentsReceived`, four decimals. Omitted when `shipmentsReceived` is 0.

discrepanciesByKind.description: Discrepancies recorded in the window per kind. The kind is the carton discrepancy kind string passed through (`MissingCarton`, `UnexpectedCarton`, `Damaged`, `Short`, `Over`); an open vocabulary. Always present, empty when there is none.

complianceViolations.description: Compliance violations recorded in the window.

complianceTier.description: Derived, informational. The worst of three signals; it suspends and blocks nothing.

schema.title: SellerScorecard

withDiscrepancies.summary: A seller with a short carton and a damaged carton

noShipments.summary: A seller with no closed shipment in the window; the rates are omitted

400.description: The `window` query value is not `7d` or `30d` (`invalid-window`).

type.description: Problem type slug: the shared `not-found`, `illegal-transition`, `concurrent-update` and `validation-failed`, or one slug per `Err...` name of this context, for example `sscc-not-unique`.

detail.example: sscc not unique: 006141420000000011 is already in this shipment
